note: One reader sees governed Knowledge at the principal, project, workspace and tenant placements on its current scope chain. Every shared item is accepted into the exact `publish_scope` through the candidate/VedaFlow path. The six principal items make the narrow budgets bind so retrieval quality, not enumeration, decides the precision probes. A different principal's unshared draft is the negative privacy control.

events.text: I always run cargo nextest over the workspace before pushing a branch.
I keep my editor on two-space indentation for every TypeScript file.
I decided to review incoming pull requests in the morning before standup.
I bring the local stack up with make dev-up in a split terminal pane.
I keep meeting notes in a single dated markdown file per week.
I bound the debugger to F5 in my editor keymap.
Payments caps card retries at three attempts with full jitter.
The payments on-call runbook lives in the ops wiki under Incident Response.
Draft only and nobody has agreed it: we might split settlement onto its own queue.
Engineering standardised on OpenTelemetry for every service trace.
Every Engineering service needs two approving reviews before merge.
ACME retains customer support transcripts for exactly ninety days.
ACME requires a signed data processing agreement before any vendor onboarding.
